item.tib: spyi 'dul rta dbu dmar chung gi phyag bzhes gsal ba'i sgron ma
item.coloph: de ltar spyi 'dul lag len gsal sgron 'di/ skyes mchog bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag len rnams/ gcig tu dril nas bkod 'di gso rig pa/ bsod rgyal bdag gi (gis) bstan 'gro'i don du spel/ blo gros brtul zhing sbyangs pa'i mthu chung bas/ mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad ma mchis pa'i/ nyes 'gal ci bgyis skyabs yul gnyan la bshags/ dge ba'i 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog/
